title: How We Solved the Worst Minigame in Zelda's History
summary: Linkus7 explains how a community reverse-engineered The Wind Waker to predict its random number generator and beat the Sploosh Kaboom battleship minigame consistently. It includes d3 animations by Peter Schmidt-Nielsen.
why: HN recommends it as a rigorous, fun example of reverse engineering a game to predict and conquer its RNG.

quote.text: is a fun video about reverse-engineering Zelda to predict the randomness in a minigame
